test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement and conclusion for pictorial drawing are given below. Determine the logical relationship between them. Statement: Pictorial drawings are three-dimensional and provide a visual representation of an object.

Conclusion: Therefore, pictorial drawings are useful for describing the shape of a piece part or component

options.text: The conclusion logically follows from the statement.
The conclusion is unrelated to the statement
The conclusion is partially supported by the statement.
The conclusion does not logically follow from the statement

solution:
The correct answer is __The conclusion logically follows from the statement.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pictorial drawings are three-dimensional and provide a visual representation of an object.
 
• They help in understanding the shape, dimensions, and overall structure of a piece part or component.
 
• Such drawings are widely used in engineering, architecture, and design industries.
 
• The conclusion logically aligns with the statement as pictorial drawings effectively describe the shape and form of objects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Applications of Pictorial Drawings:**
 
 
• Used in product design to visualize concepts before prototyping.
 
• Helps in client presentations to demonstrate ideas effectively.
 
 
 
• **Types of Pictorial Drawings:**
 
 
• Isometric drawings: Show three sides of an object in a single view.
 
• Perspective drawings: Mimic how objects appear to the human eye.
 
• Oblique drawings: Represent objects with a frontal view and depth.
